description:
What if the world's biggest problems could be solved simply by listening better?

Sound expert Julian Treasure takes us on a journey from the ancient rhythms of ocean waves to the eerie hum of a black hole — and argues that our collective failure to truly listen is costing us more than we realise. We're talking $10 trillion a year in disengagement and miscommunication, a loneliness epidemic, and leaders who don't hear the people they serve.

With warmth, wit and insight, Julian unpacks why we've lost the art of listening and shares three surprisingly simple ways to get it back.

Whether you're a business leader, a parent, or just someone who wants to connect more deeply with the world around you, this talk will change how you use your ears. ? Julian Treasure is the world’s leading authority on conscious communication, with over 2 decades dedicated to transforming how individuals and organisations connect through skilled listening and powerful speaking.
